1,0,1: George Berrington worked through the open pipeline with Chris and Leanne. Pipeline was £2.1m across 19 opportunities but stage definitions were loose and several deals had not moved in months. We agreed five stages with exit criteria and a rule for stalled deals.
5,1,1: Set up the CRM and reporting to support the new stages.
5,2,1: Leanne to share the current CRM fields and the monthly report she sends Chris.
2,1,1: £2.1m across 19 opportunities, but Leanne thought only about £900k was real. Six deals had no activity for over 60 days.
2,2,1: Proposal to win conversion is around 35%, which Chris felt was fine, but first meeting to proposal is low because partners chase every conversation.
2,3,1: Average cycle from first meeting to signed letter is 74 days. Post-acquisition work closes much faster, often in under 30 days.
3,1,1: Use five stages: Conversation, Qualified, Proposal, Verbal, Signed, with Qualified requiring the operating partner to have joined a discovery call.
3,5,1: Move any deal with no client activity for 45 days to a closed-dormant status.
3,4,1: Hold 3x coverage of the next quarter's fee target in Qualified stage or later.
3,3,1: Set a target cycle of 45 days for post-acquisition work and track it separately.
4,1,0: Re-stage all 19 open opportunities against the new criteria
